description: A controlled lowering movement from the top of a pull-up to build upper body pulling strength.
setup: Place a chair or bench under the pull-up bar so you can step up to the top position with your chin comfortably above the bar.
steps: Step or jump up to position your chin over the pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Step off the support and briefly hold your chest close to the bar.
Lower yourself slowly and under control over 3 to 5 seconds until your arms are fully straight.
Step back onto the platform and reset before the next repetition.
cues: Keep your shoulders drawn down and chest lifted throughout the descent
Count three full seconds from top to full bottom extension

mistakes.mistake: Dropping quickly during the bottom half of the descent
mistakes.fix: Resist gravity evenly all the way until elbows are fully extended

mistakes.mistake: Shrugging shoulders up toward the ears
mistakes.fix: Pack shoulder blades back and down away from your neck

rep_standard: Begins with chin held over the bar and completes only when arms reach full extension at the dead hang.
